card.title: Admit You Need Me
card.instruction: Make someone admit that they need your help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That flat-pack cupboard's leaning. I could take a look.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful. Which page explains that leftover door?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you hold it for a second?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. Just to clarify: you're asking for my help?

mechanism: A seeks an explicit admission of needing help by exposing a construction gap and naming B's requested assistance.
confusable: Unlike simply helping or demonstrating expertise, A must steer B toward acknowledging dependence.
comparison: D01-a converts a holding request into an admission; D01-b distinguishes accepting a blanket from needing its giver.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
